facts.big: is made · is called · is used · is sold
facts.label: Passivo presente
facts.sub: Use is/are + palavra do passivo para descrever produtos: It is made of metal. It is called the crown. It is used for time. It is sold in blue.

facts.label: É feito de
facts.sub: Para dizer o material, use is made of: The case is made of metal. The strap is made of rubber. Para vários objetos, use are made of: The shoes are made of leather.

facts.label: Chama-se
facts.sub: Para dar o nome de algo, use is called: This button is called the crown. Para perguntar, diga What is this called? A resposta é It is called a strap.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The passive is be + a participle.

items.why: We say It is made of metal.

items.s: “It is called the crown” gives a name.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The passive is be + a participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: is made, is sold.)
We say “It made of metal”. → Falso (We say It is made of metal.)
“It is called the crown” gives a name. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
